name: get_item_category

stack.evidence: func_001DC2A0 replaces the top item ID with a category code selected entirely from fixed item-ID ranges

notes: The category mapping is 0 for IDs 1-16, 1 for 142-157, 2 for 158-255, 3 for 17-80, 4 for 81-102, 5 for 103-118, 6 for 119-134, and -1 otherwise. func_001CCC48 and func_001CCF78 use the same ranges to select distinct item lookup tables. All 121 JP calls pass a literal item ID and immediately store the result in local 25; 89 first consume it as a switch selector for item-specific text.
